learning_outcomes.text: Understand the mathematical foundations of probability and statistics.
Solve the most common types of probabilistic problems.

syllabus_topics: Discrete random variables and their basic types
Continuous random variables and their basic types
Numerical characteristics of random variables (for instance the mean value and the variance)
Correlation and dependence of random variables
Introduction to the random variates generation
Introduction to the probabilistic information theory
Statistical inference for the simple random sample
Statistical inference for the regression line
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a preliminary assessment (30%) and a final examination (70%). The grading scale is A for 90%, B for 80%, C for 70%, D for 60%, and E for 50%.
bibliography: Harman, R., Filová, L.: Základy pravdepodobnosti pre študentov informatiky a dátovej vedy, FMFI UK, 2022.
Janková, K., Pázman, A.: Pravdepodobnosť a štatistika, UK Bratislava, 2011.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
